# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ Utility to format user‑submitted blog entries for safe web display. """ import html from typing import Final # Predefined HTML structure with placeholders for title and body. BLOG_FORMAT: Final[str] = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_blog_entry(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Prepare a blog post for display by escaping HTML special characters and inserting the sanitized headline and content into a predefined template. Parameters ---------- headline : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. content : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A fully rendered HTML string ready for safe presentation on the webpage. Raises ------ TypeError If either argument is not a string. """ if not isinstance(headline, str): raise TypeError(f"headline must be a string, got {type(headline).__name__}") if not isinstance(content, str): raise TypeError(f"content must be a string, got {type(content).__name__}") # Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS. safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) # Preserve line breaks in the body by converting newlines to
tags. safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True).replace("\n", "
\n") return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_content)
